lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: ...gone to the gentleman at the back...

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: No papers, no service history, runs.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Somebody painted her by hand. Look at that.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: Dee. It's black, it's wide, and it's going to go for way more than nine hundred.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Then it's not nine hundred. Walk away, student.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Five hundred, anyone? Five. The backpack, five hundred. Six? Seven. Eight...

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Two thousand, from the long coat at the back. Two thousand. Going...

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Told you. Come home, I'll make you noodles that aren't your own deliveries.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: ...Sir? Sir! You can't walk off a bid, sir!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Right. Bid's withdrawn. Back to the student. Nine hundred, kid?

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Sold. Nine hundred, to the backpack. God help you.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Old units wake up by themselves. What's on it?

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: A map of the city. Nine pins. Purple. No names, no route.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: ...Bring it round tomorrow. I'll wipe it.
